text: あなたのママが　あなたを　そだてた　ように　あなたも　ポケモンを　そだてるのよ

structure.jp: あなたのママが　あなたを　そだてた　ように
structure.en: just as your mom raised you

structure.jp: あなたも　ポケモンを　そだてるのよ
structure.en: you too are to raise your Pokémon

patterns.name: 〜ように (like)
patterns.explanation: ように after a verb means 'in the same way as'. そだてた　ように = 'just as she raised'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のよ after a plain verb is a womanly way of gently telling someone what to do. そだてるのよ = 'you raise them, now'.
